Of Assam Purna Sindhu Mudoi vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 25 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88864558/ 1 Department Of Personnel Personnel (B) Dispur Guwahati-06 Page No.# 2/4 5:The Principal Secretary To The Government Of Assam Finance Department Dispur Guwahati-06. 6:The Director Of Health Services Assam Hengrabari Guwahati-36. 7:The Drugs Controller Assam Hengrabari Guwahati- 36 Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr. K N Choudhury, Md I H Laskar,Mr. D J Das,Mr. M Ahmed Advocate for the Respondent : Ga, Assam, Sc, Finance,Sc, Health
texts.facts: This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner putting to challenge the impugned order dated 11.04.2025 passed by the respondent No.1 whereby the claim of the petitioner for regularization in his post as Inspector of Drugs under the Department of Health and Family Welfare was rejected. It is submitted that Page No.# 3/4 by the impugned order rejecting the claim for regularization the petitioner's services will cease to continue as orders for further extension of his services will not be issued by the Department. It is submitted that by judgment and order dated 24.11.2023 passed in the earlier writ petition being No. WP(C) No.3383/2015 and WP(C) No. 2812/2017 filed by the petitioner, the claim of regularization which was rejected earlier by the department came to be interfered with and the matter was remanded back to the department for a fresh consideration. However, by the impugned order the authorities proceeded to pass similar orders rejecting the claim of the petitioner on the same ground. It is therefore submitted that the directions of the Court have been flouted notwithstanding that no appeal or review was filed against the said judgment and order passed in the earlier writ petition by the department/respondents Being aggrieved the petitioner is before this Court seeking for appropriate directions.
